Instagram Mixcloud Website Nils moved from Gothenburg to Barcelona in 2019 with two crates of records and no plan. He started on Radio Onda filling a late slot nobody wanted, and Nordlys grew out of it. On Saturdays he hosts Ruido Blanco, mixing drone records with recordings he makes around the city. He records most sets in one take, and he keeps a running list of every track he has played on air, which listeners ask for more than the mixes. On air Every week with Nils. All shows Nordlys Slow Nordic techno, dub and space disco for Friday nights.
